subject: Game Theory
title: Coalition Formation
description: Learn Coalition Formation in one minute.

hook.text: In Germany's parliament, no party wins a majority alone. Governing requires building a coalition of parties.

buildup.text: Coalition formation is a cooperative game: parties negotiate to split cabinet seats and policy influence.

discovery.text: Minimum winning coalition theory predicts the smallest coalition holding a majority—maximizing each member's share.

twist.text: In practice, oversized coalitions form for stability. A bare majority is fragile—one defection kills it.

climax.text: Israel's notoriously fragmented parliament produces coalitions of 5-8 parties, each extracting concessions.

punchline.text: Small parties in coalitions wield outsized power.

quiz.question: What is the minimum winning coalition?
options: The smallest group that holds a majority
